text:
lena.frontend: Heads-up: planning a small console UI deploy at 09:30 PT today. Lightweight canary (5%) for 15m then ramp if smoke is clean. Who's able to monitor? :eyes:

saurabh.eng: I can take first 15m of watch. Will keep alerts open and watch metrics.

maya-ops: I'll stand by for CDN invalidation and infra rollback if needed. Triggering purge only after canary passes.

lena.frontend: thanks. quick checklist:
- build tag: `release/ui-2026-03-17-9.30`
- canary route: `ui-canary-5pct`
- smoke tests: console load, auth flow, settings save, search perf
- CDN invalidation: path `/static/console/*` (only after canary)

jen-product: can we also validate that the new banner isn't overlapping the header in older Safari? tom-ux noticed something in QA.

tom-ux: rechecked QA — minor overlap at 320px in Safari 15.6. My suggestion: hold if we see more than 1% frontend errors in Sentry.

lena.frontend: noted — we'll watch Sentry error rate and session recordings for the canary. Threshold: >1% error-rate or any regressions in header layout => rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: `deploy-ui-release/ui-2026-03-17-9.30` by lena.frontend. Canary 5% -> 25% after 15m -> 100% after +30m manual ramp.

maya-ops: CDN purge plan: I'll prepare invalidation JSON and keep the API key ready. Will only run after we confirm canary at +15m. Command I will run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.cdn.example.com/v1/invalidate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CDN_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"paths":["/static/console/*"],"replace":true}'
```

saurabh.eng: Smoke test commands I'll run (quick):
- sanity: `npm run smoke:console -- --baseUrl=https://canary.console.redwood.com`
- perf sample: `wrk -t2 -c10 -d15s https://canary.console.redwood.com/api/search`

lena.frontend: If canary looks good at +15m, we push to 25% and schedule CDN invalidation at +40m. If anything spikes we roll back immediately and maya will cancel CDN purge.

jen-product: I'm on standby for user-facing rollout comms. If we see the header bug we pause and I will notify product support to hold any outbound messaging.

maya-ops: Also adding a temporary traffic route fallback in case the canary nodes hit errors: `route policy: fallback->ui-v1` (configured). If error rate >2% we flip fallback.

lena.frontend: perfect. tagging final owners: monitoring = saurabh.eng, infra/invalidations = maya-ops, UX monitor = tom-ux, comms = jen-product. Will kick at 09:30 PT.

saurabh.eng: :+1: ping me 2 minutes before start and I'll double-check alert thresholds.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: `deploy-ui-release/ui-2026-03-17-9.30` at 1794523415. Canary rollout 5% initiated.

lena.frontend: thanks everyone — I'll post back after +15m with verdict and next steps.
